description: This file defines classes and functions for interacting with the Azure Foundry AI Agent Service API within a larger machine learning or AI framework. It includes configuration management, request transformation, environment validation, error handling, and the core completion dispatch logic specific to Azure AI Agents, supporting asynchronous streaming and token-based authentication.

classes.name: AzureAIAgentsError
classes.description: Custom exception class for errors originating from Azure AI Agent Service interactions.

classes.name: AzureAIAgentsConfig
classes.description: Configuration class encapsulating settings and methods for interacting with Azure AI Agent Service API, including request transformation, environment validation, and specific behaviors like polling and streaming support.

methods.name: bool is_azure_ai_agents_route(model: str)
methods.description: Check if a given model string corresponds to an Azure AI Agents route based on its format.

methods.name: str get_agent_id_from_model(model: str)
methods.description: Extract the agent ID segment from model strings formatted as 'azure_ai/agents/<agent_id>' or similar.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Retrieve API base URL and API key, potentially from environment variables or secrets management.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Return minimal set of OpenAI-like parameters supported in this agent environment.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Map standard OpenAI parameters to Azure-specific parameters for requests.

methods.name: str _get_api_version(self, optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Determine the API version to use, defaulting if not provided.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Construct base URL for different Azure AI agent service endpoints based on parameters.

methods.name: str _get_agent_id(self, model: str, optional_params: dict)
methods.description: Determine the agent ID from model string or optional parameters.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transform message data and request parameters into payload format for Azure Agents API, handling message content formatting.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Prepare request headers with appropriate authentication tokens for environment validation.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, httpx.Headers] )
methods.description: Return the appropriate exception class for errors based on response.

methods.name: bool should_fake_stream( self, model: Optional[str], stream: Optional[bool], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Determine if the response stream should be faked via polling, which is true for Azure Agents.

methods.name: bool has_custom_stream_wrapper(self)
methods.description: Indicate whether a custom stream wrapper is used (False for Azure Agents).

methods.name: bool supports_stream_param_in_request_body(self)
methods.description: Indicate whether stream parameter is supported in the request body (False for Azure Agents).

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Process raw responses into ModelResponse objects—here it returns the input as it's handled via custom handler.

methods.name: Any completion( model: str, messages: List, api_base: str, api_key: Optional[str], model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, timeout: Union[float, int, Any], acompletion: bool, stream: Optional[bool] = False, headers: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Core dispatch method for handling completion requests, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous (streaming) operation modes, with Azure AD token retrieval if needed.
